article.title: -(으)니까 causa
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL guide describes **-(으)니까** as a reason/cause connective and contrasts it with **-아서/어서**: it allows a following suggestion or command in examples such as “비가 오니까 여행을 취소하자,” whereas the corresponding -아서/어서 construction is disallowed. The scope here is that contrast and these documented functions.
